issues.consequence: The revision turns two supplied scenario conditions into an accounting explanation: other adjustments total zero because noncash movements do not affect the three working-capital balances. Those exclusions permit using the balance changes but do not determine every other reconciliation adjustment. A finance reader is given an unsupported reason for the zero total even though the amounts and exclusion list remain unchanged. This is an output-introduced causal claim, not an input-parity defect.
